author: ankitm3k
title: NPU Models Tests fail downloading EasyOCR detector model - DNS resolution failure
signature: urlerror urlopen error errno 11001 getaddrinfo failed downloading easyocr detector model|Network

failed_jobs.name: NPU Models Tests / 3720
failed_jobs.symptom: test_easyocr.py::TestEasyOCRConvertModel::test_convert_model[NPU-detector] fails: subprocess raised URLError getaddrinfo failed while downloading the EasyOCR detector model weights

root_cause: The NPU Models Tests (3720 platform) job runs the EasyOCR PyTorch model-hub conversion test, which attempts to download the EasyOCR detector model weights (craft_mlt_25k.pth) from an external CDN at test time via easyocr's built-in download_and_unzip helper. On this Windows self-hosted runner, that outbound DNS lookup failed with Errno 11001 (getaddrinfo failed), most likely because the runner's network/DNS/proxy configuration does not allow ad-hoc external downloads outside the configured pip/artifact proxies. This is unrelated to any code change in the analysed PR - the PR only touches GQA/MatMulNBits/GPU Gather/NPU model-serializer code, none of which affects the EasyOCR test or its model-download path. The job was already automatically retried (run_attempt 2, in_progress) at investigation time, consistent with a transient network blip rather than a deterministic break.
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the same Windows self-hosted runner network environment; cannot be reproduced from a developer machine with normal internet access. To reproduce in CI, re-run 'NPU Models Tests / 3720' and observe whether the EasyOCR detector download succeeds or fails intermittently.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'NPU Models Tests / 3720' job (already in progress as attempt 2 at analysis time); a transient DNS failure to the external EasyOCR CDN is unlikely to reproduce on retry.

If this recurs, consider vendoring/caching the EasyOCR detector/recognizer model weights through the existing pip-proxy/artifact-cache infrastructure instead of relying on ad-hoc HTTPS downloads mid-test on Windows runners.

Verify the Windows self-hosted runner pool's outbound DNS/proxy allowlist covers the EasyOCR model CDN host, or mark this specific EasyOCR NPU test as skippable/retryable when external downloads are blocked.
prevention_strategies: Avoid unmocked, ad-hoc network downloads inside CI test bodies; prefer models pre-cached in the artifact/pip proxy used elsewhere in this workflow. Add a retry-with-backoff wrapper around EasyOCR's download_and_unzip call (or monkeypatch it in the test fixture) so a single transient DNS hiccup does not fail the whole precommit run.
historical_context: No prior CI Doctor MQ pattern record for this specific EasyOCR/DNS signature was found; this is the first recorded occurrence. Other NPU Models Tests infrastructure failures previously recorded include artifact upload ENOTFOUND and openvino_wheels download-after-retries failures, both categorized Infrastructure, suggesting the Windows NPU runner pool has recurring outbound-network flakiness worth tracking.
